items.t: MP's Materials Segment Revenues Up 141% in 9M26: What's Next?
items.sum: MP Materials' Materials segment revenues surge 141% on higher NdPr sales and prices in the first nine-month period of 2026 and positive EBITDA.

items.sum: MP Materials has a budding relationship with one of the biggest companies in the tech sector.

items.t: MP Materials Is Down 27% This Year. Can Needham’s Magnet Call Get MP Stock Back to $48?
items.sum: Insiders are buying shares, Needham is bullish, and the CEO is warning of a financially painful stretch ahead. One automaker's magnet deliveries may decide which signal MP Materials investors should trust.

items.t: MP to Become Major Domestic Permanent Magnet Supplier Over Next 3 Years, Says Needham
items.sum: Needham’s bullish thesis is based on government support and MP’s long-term supply agreements with General Motors and Apple.

items.t: Three MP Materials Insiders Just Bet $3.6 Million on Their Own Stock Near Its 52-Week Low
items.sum: Three MP Materials insiders bought about $3.6 million of stock in the week it touched its 52-week low, and Needham resumed coverage at Buy with a $48 target as the rare-earth miner bounced from a two-day selloff. Here is what moved it, what the quarter showed, and what a holder or would-be buyer should weigh in a stock that has moved 3% or more in 19 of its last 35 sessions.

items.t: USA Rare Earth Climbs 7%, MP Materials Jumps 8% as Traders Eye U.S.-China Rare-Earth Talks; United States Antimony Rallies 7%
items.sum: After a brutal two-day selloff, rare-earth stocks are bouncing while the rest of the materials sector slips. Traders are betting on Washington and Beijing, but some see a short squeeze in disguise. Which companies have real backing when the trade talk fades?
